name: Crissy Field
notes: Presidio of San Francisco: PPIE aviation / drill field on the 1912-15 fill (1915), Army air coast-defense station built 1919-21 on the old racetrack (accepted 24 Jun 1921; Wikipedia), grass field '5,000 x 400 ft sandy loam' (1937 Airports Directory); Air Corps squadrons to Hamilton Field 1936; paved Runway 6/24 c.1947-48 (aerials 7/1946, 8/1948), 2,610 ft (1960); fixed-wing flying ended 1974 (Campbell, Two Hours by Crow), helicopters later. Not in Overture: outline + runway pieces in data/manual/airports_extra*.geojson (USGS San Francisco North 1946-photo sheet, 1956, 1968 PR; data/manual/airports/tools/crissy.py); runway removed 1999 for the restoration
